summary: MaintCampus is a web page and backend module that facilitates the management of campus records within an organization, including creation, editing, deletion, and reactivation. It enforces access control and validation based on user roles and provides workflows and UI controls for campus data management in a web environment.
purpose: To allow authorized users to view, add, edit, delete, and reactivate campus entries for specific departments/agencies, governed by role-based permissions and validation rules. It also provides error/warning messaging and supports consistent display and interaction via ASP.NET controls.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short name or abbreviation for the campus

fields.name: Inactive
fields.description: Status flag indicating whether the campus is inactive

workflows.name: Campus Management
steps: User loads MaintCampus page (checks access, populates dropdowns, loads data)
User selects department/agency from dropdown (data refreshes)
Grid displays campus information, with Add/Edit/Delete/Reactivate buttons based on access and status
Add/Edit: Opens popup (DetailsView), fills mandatory fields, validates, saves
Delete: Sets campus as inactive, updates grid
Reactivate: Sets campus as active, updates grid
After actions: Refreshes grid, updates UI panels

business_rules: Only users with SystemAdministrator or LocalAdministrator roles may edit.
SystemAdministrators must be assigned to the selected agency.
LocalAdministrators must have access to the selected department.
ViewOnly users may not edit campus information.
Mandatory fields: Name (max 50 chars), ShortName (max 10 chars).
validations: Name must be specified (error message: Name_must_be_specified)
ShortName must be specified (error message: ShortName_must_be_specified)
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is set only if user role and access checks pass
Grid buttons and edit fields enabled/disabled based on ScreenIsEditable and Inactive status
If campus is inactive, show Reactivate option
If grid is empty, show Add button and no data message
system_behavior: GridView and DetailsView bind and display data
Panels display error/warning/status messages as appropriate
Modal popup used for Add/Edit forms
Dropdowns for agency/department trigger data refresh
Inactive campuses hidden unless Show Inactive is checked
dependencies: Agencies and Departments modules for dropdown data
exceptions: Unauthorized access disables editing and hides buttons
Errors and warnings displayed in error/warning panels
